answer: Sybil tax: every new vertex pays a 50-credit entry tax, burned never refunded. First, the agent posts the tax before it can trade. Second, a whisper network of peers gossips each receipt; a vertex without one is ignored, so fakes cannot hide in silence. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits burned for zero return, while an honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full rewards undiluted. The sable ledger marks each paid vertex.
